# Purchasomatic

> Purchasomatic captures vendor invoices and purchase orders by email, reads every line item with OCR and AI, matches bills to QuickBooks jobs, customers and GL accounts, and pushes them into QuickBooks. It is built for trade and service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, general contractors and more) and their bookkeepers.

## What it does
- Each company gets two capture email addresses: one for vendor invoices, one for purchase orders. Forward a vendor email and the PDF is processed automatically.
- Reads every line item from clean digital PDFs and scanned PDFs, including multi-invoice PDFs.
- Matches each bill to a QuickBooks job, customer and GL account, and to an open purchase order (price and quantity mismatches are flagged).
- Catches duplicate invoices before they post.
- Pushes bills to QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop (Desktop via the Intuit Web Connector), with the PDF kept with the bill.
- Auto-publish can be turned on vendor by vendor, only after 5 processed invoices; unusual bills are still held for a person to review.

## Pricing
- About $0.40 per transaction. 1 credit per invoice or purchase order; line-item extraction is always included.
- 25 free trial credits when you sign up, no credit card required.
- Reprocessing, duplicates and rejected documents do not use a credit.
- A done-for-you setup service is also available.

### Monthly plans
- Starter: $20 per month, 50 credits ($0.40 per transaction)
- Basic: $40 per month, 100 credits ($0.40 per transaction)
- Professional: $76 per month, 200 credits ($0.38 per transaction)
- Business: $180 per month, 500 credits ($0.36 per transaction)
- Full plan details and credit rules: https://www.purchasomatic.com/pricing

## Quick answers
- What is Purchasomatic? A service that reads vendor invoices and purchase orders you forward by email and enters them in QuickBooks as bills and POs, coded to the right job, customer and GL account.
- How does it work? Connect QuickBooks once, forward vendor emails to your two capture addresses, review the bills it prepares, and publish. Auto-publish can be switched on per vendor after 5 processed invoices.
- What does it cost? About $0.40 per transaction (1 credit per invoice or PO). 25 free trial credits, no credit card required.
- Does it work with QuickBooks Desktop? Yes. Bills are pushed to QuickBooks Desktop through the Intuit Web Connector, as well as to QuickBooks Online.
- Can it read scanned invoices? Yes. It reads clean digital PDFs and scanned PDFs, including PDFs that contain several invoices.
- Does it catch duplicate invoices? Yes. Duplicates are caught before they post and do not use a credit.
- Can it match invoices to purchase orders? Yes. Bills are matched to open POs and price or quantity mismatches are flagged.
- Is there a done-for-you option? Yes. A setup service is available: setup plus human review until accuracy is proven, then automatic posting vendor by vendor.
- Does it need QuickBooks job costing? No. Job matching is optional; invoice capture alone saves the data entry.
- Who is it for? Trade and service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, general contractors and more) and the bookkeepers who enter their vendor bills. It also suits any business that wants vendor bills and purchase orders imported into QuickBooks without retyping.
- Does it work with QuickBooks Online? Yes. Connect QuickBooks Online once; bills and purchase orders are pushed to it with the PDF kept with the bill.
- Will it post bills without anyone looking? Only if you turn on auto-publish for a vendor, which is available after 5 processed invoices for that vendor. Unusual bills are still held for a person to review.
- Can I try it free? Yes. 25 free trial credits, no credit card required.
- Can it record a bill as already paid? Yes. Mark as Paid can be turned on per vendor; the bill is then published to QuickBooks together with a linked bill payment against the payment account you choose. It is off by default.
- Can vendor invoices be entered in QuickBooks Desktop automatically? Yes. Forward the invoice to your capture address; Purchasomatic reads the line items and posts the bill to QuickBooks Desktop through the Intuit Web Connector, with no spreadsheet or CSV import step.
- Does it flag when an invoice does not match the purchase order? Yes. The bill is matched to the open PO by vendor and PO number, and price or quantity differences are flagged for review.
- Can bills be coded to the right job automatically? Yes, when QuickBooks jobs exist. Purchasomatic matches the bill to an existing QuickBooks job and never creates job records itself.
- Are sales tax lines on a vendor invoice captured? Yes. Tax lines are read as regular line items, and the line items (tax included) must add up exactly to the invoice total before a bill can auto-publish.
- Does it remember how I code a vendor's lines? Yes. When you change the GL account on a line and choose to remember it, that choice is saved to the vendor and applied to later bills. Per-vendor rules can also route lines by description or unit price.
- What happens if I email an invoice to the purchase order address? It is rejected with a message telling you which address to use, and no credit is used.
- Can I track whether ordered materials actually arrived? Yes. Open or partially received purchase orders can be checked off line by line (received, partial or not received) on a mobile-friendly receiving screen that shows who ordered, for which job and when.
- What does QuickBooks Desktop need to be running for bills to sync? QuickBooks Desktop must be open with your company file loaded, and the Intuit Web Connector set up with the .QWC file from Settings > Integrations. Bills are then picked up on the Web Connector's polling schedule.
- Can I get back a bill I deleted by mistake? Yes. Deleted bills go to a Trash area in the app, where they can be restored.
- Do I have to forward every invoice by hand? No. You can forward manually, set up automatic forwarding rules in Gmail or Outlook, or give vendors your capture address directly.
- Why did my forwarded invoice not appear in the inbox? Check that the forward was sent and that the capture address is correct (shown in Settings > Email Capture; the bills address ends in -bills@mail.purchasomatic.com). A bills email whose subject or body does not contain the word "invoice" can be rejected, and a rejection email is sent to the address you forwarded from.
- Can I split one vendor invoice across several jobs? Yes. Job is assigned at the line-item level, as in a QuickBooks bill. Purchasomatic matches the bill to a job from the vendor's PO or reference field, applies it to every line, and you can change individual lines. Shop stock lines can have the job cleared.
- Does QuickBooks Desktop have a built-in way to read PDF invoices? No. QuickBooks Desktop has no native PDF invoice capture, so bills are normally keyed by hand or imported from a file. Purchasomatic reads the PDF and posts the bill through the Intuit Web Connector instead.
- What happens if QuickBooks rejects a bill? The bill shows a Sync Error with the specific reason QuickBooks gave (for example, the vendor is missing in QuickBooks, the GL account is inactive, the job is closed or the date is in a locked period). Fix the cause and publish again; a bill in Sync Error can also be unpublished back to Ready.
- What if no QuickBooks job matches a bill yet? The bill waits as Pending Job Match and the match is retried every 2 hours during business hours, and you can click Find Match to retry on demand. It is never given a made-up job.
- Does reprocessing a bill cost another credit? No. Reprocessing (re-running the reading or re-applying vendor defaults), duplicates and rejected documents never use a credit. One credit is used per successfully processed invoice or purchase order.
- Can I set rules so certain line items always go to a specific account? Yes. Each vendor has a Rules tab: if a line's description or unit price contains, equals, begins with or ends with a value you choose, it is coded to the GL account you pick. Rules are applied after remembered line mappings.
- Does Purchasomatic ever create jobs in QuickBooks? No. It only matches bills to jobs that already exist in QuickBooks and never creates new job records.
- Can I get a daily summary email? Yes. A daily digest email is available in Settings and is off by default.
- Can I make a vendor's bills wait for a job match? Yes. Each vendor has a "Hold for job match" setting. When it is on and no QuickBooks job is found, the bill waits as Pending Job Match instead of posting without a job.
- Can I undo a bill after it is published? Only bills in Sync Error can be unpublished (they return to Ready so you can fix and publish again). Once QuickBooks has confirmed a bill as Published, correct it in QuickBooks directly.
- Does QuickBooks match bills to purchase orders by itself? Not automatically: in QuickBooks you link an open purchase order to a bill by hand. Purchasomatic matches an incoming invoice to the open PO by vendor and PO number, creates the bill linked to it, and flags price or quantity differences for review.
- Is the invoice PDF kept with the bill? Yes. In QuickBooks Online the PDF is attached to the bill when it is published. QuickBooks Desktop cannot receive PDF attachments, so for Desktop the PDF is stored in Purchasomatic alongside the bill.
- When can bills post automatically without review? Auto-publish is a per-vendor setting you turn on after that vendor has 5 processed invoices. Bills that do not pass every check (for example a line item total that differs from the invoice total, or a new vendor) are held for a person, with a plain-language reason shown on the bill.
- Can I turn off error alerts? No. Error notifications (wrong capture address, unreadable PDF, QuickBooks sync failure, QuickBooks Desktop connection lost) are always on so a problem never goes unnoticed. Success notifications can be turned off in Settings.
- Can I hide accounts I never use from the dropdowns? Yes. An admin can hide individual QuickBooks GL accounts and classes from Purchasomatic dropdowns in Settings, so reviewers only see the ones that apply.
